Medical History

  - Noted pink discoloration of urine; possible hematuria but patient uncertain.
  - Increased urinary frequency (patient attributes partly to increased fluid intake); no dysuria reported.
  - Recent constipation last week, now resolved.
  - Concern for possible pregnancy raised given Implanon use; patient thinks pregnancy unlikely but agrees to pregnancy test.
  - No prior similar episodes reported.

Management Plan
